hypotheses.claim: Adjusting score_merge_static to use a stricter distance-increase penalty and a stronger reward for high capacity utilization will prevent suboptimal merges, leading to a further objective reduction of 0.03 to 0.06 versus the current best of 17.8168.

next_search_advice.direction: Refine the static merge scoring to more heavily penalize distance increase while rewarding merges that improve capacity utilization and spatial overlap, keeping all other framework components unchanged.
